note: Set B is better because it correctly extracts the circuit topology (connections between SA modules like SA3-16 to SA3-17) and the bonding jumper gauge (#10G) from the legend, which are critical engineering facts. Set A focuses repetitively on the internal '3' value and incorrectly attributes the UV rating to the cable instead of cable ties (Note 2). Both sets erroneously claim a connection to 'Mounting Rails' and handle the 'ENMA' OCR error by correcting it to 'NEMA' in the attribute, but Set B's hallucination of 'Inverter Equipment' (vs Planter) is outweighed by its superior extraction of the schematic connectivity.
